description: 2016 SoE Built environment Passenger rail kilometres travelled in Australian capital cities 1991 to 2014 financial years is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by State of the Environment. Billions of passenger kilometres travelled in Australian capital cities, combined light and heavy rail, financial years 1990-91 to 2013-2014. This data was sourced from the Bureau of Infrastructure, Transport and Regional Economics. For more information see Figure BLT26 in Built environment. See. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher State of the Environment. Its tags are 2016, 2016 SoE, Built environment, SoE, SoE Graph. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
